user: Clicking the black rim around the Risk 42 dartboard now registers as a miss instead of doing nothing
what: The two black rim circles around the board now submit a miss (hit(0, 1)) when clicked; the guard for disabled boards lives inside hit() and the colored scoring paths still paint on top so real scores keep click priority
why: Darts that physically landed on the rim were silently ignored before — players had to throw again or lose input; now every board click is recorded
next: Play a Risk 42 match and try throwing at the board rim — every hit now counts

user: Log a miss by simply clicking the black rim of the Risk board — no more hunting for the small Miss button
what: On /match/risk, the outer black no-point zone of the board is now clickable: it records a miss, consumes a dart, and logs it in the war log. Scoring segments keep click priority, the Miss button still works, and the hint line now reads "· black rim = miss".
why: A miss is one of the most common inputs — clicking where the dart landed is faster and more natural than finding a small button under the board.
next: Open /match/risk and try clicking the black rim — darts should drop 3→1 and the war log should note the miss.

why: Players no longer have to leave the game (or ask) to check how a rule works mid-match.
